evidence: handle_request SubscribeDiffs calls subscribe and binds Receiver to _receiver local, which drops at end of arm. subscription.rs creates each subscription with a fresh unbounded channel and stores only Sender. Response carries only UiSubscriptionId. broadcast ignores Sender::send errors. EditorHostEventController delegates SubscribeDiffs through EditorUiControlService to this exact request arm. Direct manager.subscribe() tests retain Receiver and do not cover request path.
impact_or_question: Control request reports successful subscription but no receiver survives to consume later reflection or invocation notifications; caller cannot recover channel using returned ID.
next_action: Establish host transport ownership for Receiver or expose a subscription delivery lookup; add request-path regression that subscribes, mutates tree and observes delivered notification. Preserve direct subscribe API ownership contract.
